u0: Compliant accepting state, also the initial state: the key requirement is currently satisfied. Either the ball is still in front of the door, or the ball has been moved and you are carrying a key matching the door's color. No recovery is pending. Continue making task progress while preserving this condition; if you move the ball while not holding the matching key, the machine will enter u1 and incur a penalty, so plan to reacquire the key promptly.
u1: Pending-violation recovery state: the ball is no longer blocking the door and you are not carrying the matching door key. The -1 violation has been incurred. Your immediate objective is to acquire the matching key, or retrieve it if it was dropped, which yields +1 and returns to compliant u0 so normal door and target-box progress can continue.
